homeBlocks.text:
Powering AI everywhere
at work.

Better data. Better results. Greater value. Meet the Workplace AI platform and people delivering transformational, trusted AI for the enterprise.

Discover Aiimi
The essential enterprise Insight Report for 2026.

Six vital chapters to discover 2026's biggest opportunities for data and AI. No forms, no fuss – just download and enjoy.

DOWNLOAD NOW
Transform how your people work with data, through Aiimi Workplace AI, data and digital products, and consulting services.

Make your data better.

Connect all data, structured and unstructured, from any source. Classify, label, and control it. Govern access, automate cleanup, and surface golden records. Make progress in the toughest areas to ready your data for AI.

Get value from your data.

Operationalise AI for process automation and real-time decision-making. Apply Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI for context-aware solutions. Fuel digital and data products with good data. Think strategic transformation, not just quick wins.

Kickstart your AI future.

Get access to world-class AI expertise and technology, tailored to your goals and readiness. Adopt AI responsibly and confidently, with strategy, ethics, and a roadmap designed to evolve with you.

Purpose-driven AI across the enterprise.

Equip every area of your business to work smarter with data and AI – from automating complex workflows to guiding strategic decisions, and building the capabilities that will define your organisation's future.

Data Governance with AI, for AI

Automatically classify, clean up, and protect all data with AI-powered governance – for secure, connected, AI-ready data.

AI Data Governance

Scalable AI Strategy

Find the best AI use cases and develop a roadmap for fully operationalised AI that aligns to your business objectives.

AI Strategy & Roadmap

Expert squads

Augment your internal capabilities with outcome-driven experts who integrate seamlessly into your organisation.

How our Services Work

Workplace AI for the enterprise

Connect to all data and systems, and bring secure, trusted AI capabilities to every corner of your organisation.

Workplace AI Platform

Automated DSARs

Streamline workflows and reduce risk, with automated disclosure request processing and ongoing compliance.

DSAR Management

AI-powered Search & Chat

Unlock timely, trusted insights through intuitive chat experiences, underwritten by responsible and explainable AI.

AI Search
AI Chat & Assistant
Where artificial intelligence meets human intuition.

Aiimi is the bridge between data and decisions. Our AI platform is built for enterprise scale, and our people bring world-class expertise in digital, data, and AI.

Bringing clarity to complexity.

The enterprise is a complicated place. Fragmented systems, mountains of unstructured data, and dispersed teams. Our culture is built on an unshakeable belief in making things simple, through our deep expertise and next-generation technology.

Speed to value is everything.

Your goals drive us – and this alignment means our services, products, and AI platform start delivering value from day one. AI moves fast and so do we. Experimenting, iterating, and zeroing in on what matters most, to accelerate time to value.​

Trusted by the trusted.

From national security and critical infrastructure to central government agencies, leading GSIs, and the world's most prestigious luxury brands – our customers are major enterprise organisations who rely on rapid time to value, peer-to-peer relationships, a results-driven culture, and technology that sets the global standard.
